**Summary**  
The GNN-A model assigns patient C3L-00583 a very low out-of-fold risk (0.0005) for stage III–IV ccRCC [pred:C3L-00583:gnn]. Tumor-derived protein features contribute ~78 % of the top drivers, led by strongly down‑regulated CORO2B, L1CAM and EMC2 [contrib:C3L-00583:NCBIGene:10391][contrib:C3L-00583:NCBIGene:3897][contrib:C3L-00583:NCBIGene:9694], while the recorded phenotype Asthma accounts for the remaining ~22 % [contrib:C3L-00583:HP:0002099]. The tumor carries canonical ccRCC somatic mutations in VHL, MTOR, PBRM1 and KDM5C [pt:C3L-00583:somatic_mutation:NCBIGene:7428][pt:C3L-00583:somatic_mutation:NCBIGene:2475][pt:C3L-00583:somatic_mutation:NCBIGene:55193][pt:C3L-00583:somatic_mutation:NCBIGene:8242] and shows marked up‑regulation of metabolic enzymes (ERO1A, LRRK2, PYGL, LDHA, PGK1) and EGFR [pt:C3L-00583:protein_up:NCBIGene:30001][pt:C3L-00583:protein_up:NCBIGene:120892][pt:C3L-00583:protein_up:NCBIGene:5836][pt:C3L-00583:protein_up:NCBIGene:3939][pt:C3L-00583:protein_up:NCBIGene:5230][pt:C3L-00583:protein_up:NCBIGene:1956].

**Evidence paths**  
- Somatic VHL p.H115Y → VHL protein in nucleoplasm → antigen‑processing/ubiquitination pathway [E3598872][E3825754].  
- Somatic MTOR p.L2431K → MTOR in ER membrane [E3571444].  
- HIF1A protein–protein interactions with YWHAG and LDHA link hypoxia sensing to glycolysis [E181866][E220163].  
- TP53 interacts with LRRK2 and ARHGEF7, connecting stress response to cytoskeletal regulation [E271237][E290422].  
- Down‑regulated CORO2B, L1CAM, EMC2 are top tumor drivers of the low risk score [contrib:C3L-00583:NCBIGene:10391][contrib:C3L-00583:NCBIGene:3897][contrib:C3L-00583:NCBIGene:9694].  
- Asthma phenotype is the sole clinical driver [contrib:C3L-00583:HP:0002099].

- Fostamatinib inhibits SRC, GSK3B and CSNK2A1 [E333950][E335259][E336019] – SRC and GSK3B are implicated in ccRCC signaling but not directly tied to this patient’s drivers.

The tumor carries canonical ccRCC somatic mutations in VHL, MTOR, PBRM1 and KDM5C [pt:C3L-00583:somatic_mutation:NCBIGene:7428][pt:C3L-00583:somatic_mutation:NCBIGene:2475][pt:C3L-00583:somatic_mutation:NCBIGene:55193][pt:C3L-00583:somatic_mutation:NCBIGene:8242] and shows marked up‑regulation of metabolic enzymes (ERO1A, LRRK2, PYGL, LDHA, PGK1) and EGFR [pt:C3L-00583:protein_up:NCBIGene:30001][pt:C3L-00583:protein_up:NCBIGene:120892][pt:C3L-00583:protein_up:NCBIGene:5836][pt:C3L-00583:protein_up:NCBIGene:3939][pt:C3L-00583:protein_up:NCBIGene:5230][pt:C3L-00583:protein_up:NCBIGene:1956].

- Asthma phenotype is the sole clinical driver [contrib:C3L-00583:HP:0002099].
